manychat.seoTitle: Jawab24 vs ManyChat: Best Auto-Reply for Arabic Businesses (2026)
manychat.seoDescription: Compare Jawab24 and ManyChat for Facebook and Instagram auto-replies. See which tool is better for Arabic-speaking businesses with Shopify and Salla integration.
manychat.subtitle: ManyChat is a flow builder first: on its $14 Essential tier you build the conversation paths yourself, and AI replies only unlock on the $29 Pro tier. Jawab24 is AI-first from $15 — it answers from your Business Info in context, with no flows to build. Built Arabic-first, with dialect detection, a full RTL interface, and every price checked against your catalog.
manychat.advantage1: Arabic-first: Jawab24 understands 6 Arabic dialect families (Gulf, Egyptian, Levantine, Maghrebi, Iraqi, MSA) and Franco-Arabic, and its entire interface is right-to-left Arabic. ManyChat's AI answers in major languages, but it has no Arabic dialect handling and no RTL interface.
manychat.advantage2: Native Salla integration: Jawab24 syncs your Salla product catalog automatically. ManyChat does not support Salla at all.
manychat.advantage3: Price hallucination detection: Jawab24 verifies every price the AI mentions against your actual catalog. ManyChat's AI can generate incorrect prices.
manychat.advantage4: Automatic confidence scoring: Jawab24 scores every reply and holds the uncertain ones for human review by itself, without you watching the queue. ManyChat's safeguard is manual — you approve its AI comment replies yourself, or preview its suggested DM replies.
manychat.faqQ1: Is Jawab24 better than ManyChat for Arabic businesses?
manychat.faqA1: Yes. Jawab24 is designed for Arabic-first businesses with 6 dialect families, full RTL interface, and native Salla integration — features ManyChat does not offer.
manychat.faqA2: No. ManyChat integrates with Shopify but does not support Salla. Jawab24 supports Shopify, Salla and Zid natively, on every paid plan from Starter up.
manychat.faqQ3: Which is more affordable, Jawab24 or ManyChat?
manychat.faqA3: Jawab24's Starter plan is $15/month and includes 1,500 Smart Replies, unlimited Post Replies, Arabic dialect detection, price hallucination detection, and Shopify, Salla and Zid store integration. ManyChat's $14/month Essential tier includes no AI at all — AI replies to DMs and comments start on the Pro tier at $29/month with 2,500 active contacts. Both figures are annual-billed rates. ManyChat also charges by active contacts rather than by replies: exceeding the cap no longer stops your automations, it adds a per-contact overage fee, so your bill grows with your audience. Jawab24 never meters Post Replies by audience size.

speedly.seoTitle: Jawab24 vs Speedly: AI Auto-Reply Comparison for Arabic Businesses (2026)
speedly.seoDescription: Compare Jawab24 and Speedly for Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp auto-replies. Side-by-side on pricing, AI billing model, e-commerce integration, and Arabic features.
speedly.subtitle: Speedly is an Arabic-only auto-reply platform serving the Libyan and broader Arab market. Jawab24 supports both Arabic and English with full RTL and LTR interfaces, plus native Shopify and Salla integration. The biggest practical pricing difference: Jawab24 includes AI usage in the subscription, while Speedly charges AI credits separately on top of the subscription.
speedly.advantage1: All-inclusive pricing: Jawab24 bundles AI generation into the subscription, so you pay one predictable monthly bill. Speedly's pricing requires adding AI credits on top of the subscription, so your monthly cost grows with reply volume.
speedly.advantage2: Native e-commerce integration: Jawab24 syncs product catalogs from Shopify and Salla so AI replies use real prices and availability. Speedly does not integrate with external e-commerce platforms — it offers a built-in store instead.
speedly.advantage3: Price hallucination detection: Jawab24 verifies every AI-generated price against your product catalog before sending. This is a Jawab24-specific safeguard that prevents the AI from inventing prices in replies.
speedly.advantage4: Business Info with RAG: Jawab24 grounds replies in your verified business data through retrieval-augmented generation, with confidence scoring that holds uncertain replies for human review.
speedly.faqQ1: How does pricing actually differ between Jawab24 and Speedly?
speedly.faqA1: Jawab24's monthly subscription covers AI generation — one fixed bill regardless of how many replies the AI handles. Speedly's subscription does not include AI usage; you add AI credits separately, so your effective cost increases with reply volume. The right comparison depends on your monthly reply count.
speedly.faqQ2: Does Speedly include AI usage in the subscription?
speedly.faqA2: No. Per Speedly's own site, AI is activated by adding AI credits to your account separately from the subscription. Jawab24 includes AI generation in the subscription price — no separate credit purchases.
speedly.faqQ3: Which is better for a Shopify or Salla store owner?
speedly.faqA3: Jawab24, because it natively syncs your Shopify or Salla product catalog so AI replies quote real prices and availability. Speedly does not integrate with Shopify or Salla — it provides a built-in store instead, which means migrating off your existing platform.
